description: Residual of the object list against the radar's own ACC target as a function of each uncertainty code: Gaussian-ML fit sd^2 = floor^2 + (k*code)^2 on mature, position-matched, unique object/ACC pairs (drive set A, 483 segments, every 4th matched record, 65,638 pairs); 90 % bootstrap over segments.

residuals.240|7: slot over-ground speed minus ego speed minus ACC relative speed (m/s)
residuals.248|7: slot lateral ground speed minus ACC lateral speed (m/s)

confidence.240|7: likely: .043 m/s per count, same as the earlier excursion_sigma_scale fit (.045); a fitted Gaussian-equivalent over heavy tails, not a decoded unit
confidence.232|7: likely: .10 m per count and constant across range bands (.10-.12); codes run only 0-9, so it is coarse near 0
confidence.224|7: candidate: .23 m per count overall (.24 at 5-40 m), falling to .15 (40-80 m) and .05 (80+ m) while the floor rises to 4-8 m: beyond 40 m most of the range error is not graded by the code
confidence.248|7: candidate: .37 m/s per count; the reference mixes ground lateral speed with the ACC's relative lateral speed
confidence.256|8: candidate: follows the frame scatter of 84|10 (.0062 m/s^2 per count, plus a .045 floor); no reference acceleration exists, so no error unit

limits: The reference is the radar's own ACC estimate: these are relative units (an upper bound on sensor error plus ACC error and slot-vs-ACC bias), not physical truth. 256|8, 264|8 and 200|7 have no error unit.

frame_scatter_k_per_count.description: Self-referenced check: white-noise-equivalent frame-to-frame scatter (second difference / sqrt 6) of each native quantity on 217,031 mature continuous slot-run triples (drive set A), sd^2 = floor^2 + (k*code)^2; 90 % bootstrap over segments.

frame_scatter_axis_spearman: |scatter| against the code within range bands: yRel~232|7 .19-.27, lateral speed~248|7 .16-.19, 84|10~256|8 .13-.23 (the only consistent link), vRel~240|7 .29 at <=25 m falling to ~0 beyond 70 m, dRel~224|7 weak (.28 at <=25 m, negative beyond 70 m); 264|8 follows lateral speed (.08-.18), not 84|10 or yRel.
scatter_to_error_ratio: Per-count frame scatter is about 20 % of the ACC-referenced error (232|7 .021 vs .104; 240|7 .008 vs .043; 224|7 .063 vs .227): the codes describe temporally correlated tracker error, of which record-to-record jitter is a fifth.
